verdict.rationale: Asana documents an App Directory with many third-party apps and app components plugging into the UI, plus API/webhooks for building custom integrations, supporting the marketplace-integration story. However, there's no evidence pack confirmation of the marketplace's actual scale ('thousands' of apps) or independent corroboration of breadth. Missing for 10: explicit count/scale of App Directory listings, independent third-party validation of ecosystem breadth, and details on app discovery/installation UX.
